auth.description: Local name-and-password sign-in. localLogin false offers only single sign-on (config.auth.oidc required), refuses POST /api/login, creates no bootstrap administrator and rejects sessions of local accounts.

decider.description: The decider the tripwire asks (RFC-0008). Off unless enabled; live mode only.

credentialsSecret.description: Live mode: every key of this Secret becomes the workbench's environment through envFrom.

credentialRefs.description: One Secret key per credential: each entry sets the environment variable it is named after from {name, key} through secretKeyRef, ahead of credentialsSecret. Live mode only.

allowFileOnDataVolume.description: Live mode without a store key Secret: true keeps the key in a file on the data volume and the install notes warn; false makes the chart refuse to render.

externalSecrets.description: ExternalSecret resources (external-secrets.io/v1) for the store key and single credentials. Values name where each secret lives in the store, never the secret itself.

config.description: The Unfold configuration file the chart renders, apart from the keys it writes itself (docs/contracts/config.v1.schema.json, generated by scripts/config-reference.mjs).

mode.description: Set by the chart value mode; leave it out of config.

host.description: Address the HTTP server binds. UNFOLD_HOST overrides it.

port.description: Port the HTTP server listens on. UNFOLD_PORT overrides it.

dataDir.description: Set by the chart, as /data/workbench; leave it out of config.

publicDir.description: Set by the chart, as /app/public; leave it out of config.

baseUrl.description: Public URL people reach Unfold at; an https URL turns on secure cookies and HSTS. UNFOLD_BASE_URL overrides it.

maxConcurrentSessions.description: How many sessions run at the same time.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Largest budget in US dollars one session may request.

repositories.description: The repositories sessions may work on. Demo mode replaces them with the bundled example.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug that names the repository.

description.description: One line people see under the name.

url.description: Clone URL; in live mode an HTTP(S) URL without credentials.

baseBranch.description: Branch work starts from and pull requests target.

verify.description: Verification command as argv, run in the workspace, such as ["npm", "test"].

trackerUrl.description: Link to the repository's issue tracker.

executionOwner.description: Who runs work on this repository: people from the workbench (interactive) or Ploeg.

access.description: Basic credentials the workspace clones with. Prefer kubernetes.gitSecretName, which keeps the password out of this file.

mcp.description: Read-only gateway MCP tools for sessions on this repository: session keys are minted into this LiteLLM team with exactly these access groups.

litellmTeamId.description: LiteLLM team the session key is minted into.

accessGroups.description: MCP access groups the key may use.

tenant.description: Tenant that owns the repository (system ADR-0017); the default Tenant when absent.

client.description: Client inside the Tenant that owns the repository.

teams.description: The Teams sessions run with, each a list of Roles run in order. Absent means the delivery and investigation Teams; demo mode uses delivery only.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug that names the Team.

description.description: One line people see under the name.

id.description: Role id, unique in the Team.

mode.description: write may change the repository; read may not.

instruction.description: What the Role is told to do.

model.description: Model id from models; the session's or the first when absent.

maxToolCalls.description: Tool calls this Role may make in a Run; runtime.maxToolCalls when absent.

crews.description: Retired name of teams (system ADR-0036), still read. Set teams instead; both with different lists stops Unfold.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug that names the Team.

description.description: One line people see under the name.

id.description: Role id, unique in the Team.

mode.description: write may change the repository; read may not.

instruction.description: What the Role is told to do.

model.description: Model id from models; the session's or the first when absent.

maxToolCalls.description: Tool calls this Role may make in a Run; runtime.maxToolCalls when absent.

models.description: The models a session or Role may pick; the first is the default.

id.description: Id a Role's model or a session refers to.

providerId.description: Provider id in the agent's OpenCode configuration.

runtime.description: Set by the chart, as the kubernetes backend; leave it out of config.

docker.description: The Docker workspace backend. Read when runtime.backends lists docker.

image.description: Agent image, such as unfold-agent:1.18.30. Required for the docker backend.

socketPath.description: Docker Engine socket; the engine's default when absent.

user.description: Numeric uid or uid:gid the container runs as.

memoryMb.description: Memory per workspace container, in MiB.

gatewayUrl.description: Gateway URL as the container reaches it, when it differs from litellm.baseUrl.

transport.description: publish exposes the agent server on a host port; pull has the worker connect back to relayUrl.

relayUrl.description: Workbench URL the container's worker connects back to (transport pull).

provisionTimeoutMs.description: How long a container may take to become ready, in milliseconds.

kubernetes.description: Set by the chart's workspace* values; leave it out of config.

baseUrl.description: Inference URL including /v1. LITELLM_BASE_URL overrides it.

adminUrl.description: Gateway root the Status page checks; baseUrl without /v1 when absent. LITELLM_ADMIN_URL overrides it.

ttl.description: Lifetime of a session key minted without Ploeg.

settlementDelayMs.description: How long after a Run ends Unfold waits before it reads the gateway's final spend, in milliseconds.

masterKey.description: Never set here: the gateway master key belongs in LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.

taskSources.description: Tracker projects Unfold imports tasks from. Demo mode adds a fixture source when absent.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug that names the source.

provider.description: Tracker kind; demo is the fixture tracker of demo mode.

baseUrl.description: Tracker API root, such as https://forge.example/api/v1; HTTPS except on loopback.

project.description: Repository, project or list on the tracker, in the provider's own form.

repositoryId.description: Registered repository the source's tasks change.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the tracker API token.

executionOwner.description: Who runs the source's tasks: people from the workbench, or Ploeg.

ploeg.description: The Ploeg target tasks of this source are handed off to (Vikunja and ClickUp, executionOwner ploeg).

target.description: Forge repository the work lands in; it must match the registered repository.

baseBranch.description: Base branch; the registered repository's baseBranch.

tenant.description: Tenant that owns the source; it must own the repository too.

client.description: Client inside the Tenant that owns the source.

localLogin.description: Set by the chart value auth.localLogin; the chart refuses it under config.

secureCookies.description: Whether cookies carry Secure; on when baseUrl is https.

sessionHours.description: How long a sign-in lasts, in hours.

bootstrapName.description: Name of the administrator created at first start; overrides UNFOLD_ADMIN_NAME.

agentHostOrigins.description: Page origins an agent host WebSocket may connect from, such as vscode-file://vscode-app, or * for any.

agentHostOriginMode.description: report logs an agent host connection from another origin; enforce refuses it.

oidc.description: Single sign-on through an OpenID Connect provider.

subjectNamespace.description: Namespace that keeps subjects apart when the issuer URL changes.

clientSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the client secret, for a confidential client.

displayName.description: Provider name on the sign-in button.

roleClaim.description: Claim that names a person's role directly.

groupsClaim.description: Claim that lists a person's groups.

ploeg.description: The Ploeg API Unfold reads from and acts through. Live mode requires it.

url.description: Ploeg API origin or base path, without credentials, query or fragment.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding Unfold's Ploeg operator consumer token; required unless demo.

teams.description: Ploeg Teams Unfold's consumer may use.

userTeams.description: Ploeg Teams each Unfold user may use, by user id.

forgeLogins.description: Forge login of each Unfold user, by user id.

trackerUrl.description: Link to the tracker Ploeg dispatches from.

demo.description: Shows Ploeg's illustrative demo records; demo mode only.

personTokens.description: Exchanges each person's sign-in token for a Ploeg-audience token sent with every change Unfold makes for them (Unfold ADR 0055). Needs auth.oidc.

clientSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the exchange client secret.

execution.description: Shared execution under Ploeg. Live mode requires it.

team.description: Ploeg Team sessions run under; within ploeg.teams when that is set.

heartbeatMs.description: How often Unfold renews its execution lease with Ploeg, in milliseconds.

links.description: Accounts people link to act on other forges and trackers as themselves.

gitlab.description: Linking a GitLab account through OAuth.

clientId.description: OAuth application id. UNFOLD_GITLAB_CLIENT_ID overrides it.

clickup.description: Linking a ClickUp account through OAuth.

clientId.description: OAuth application id. UNFOLD_CLICKUP_CLIENT_ID overrides it.

clientSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the OAuth client secret.

appUrl.description: ClickUp application URL people authorize at.

gatewayPolicy.description: Providers and regions the retired standalone path allowed; refused together with execution in live mode, where the gateway enforces residency.

observability.description: Links from sessions and Runs into the estate's Grafana.

dashboards.description: Grafana dashboard uids by short name, such as spend or reliability.

logsUrl.description: Logs query API URL, for pod logs per Run.

retentionDays.description: Days audit records are kept. UNFOLD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS overrides it.

otlpUrl.description: OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint the audit is sent to. UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_URL overrides it.

openbao.description: The OpenBao Transit key that signs each Tenant's daily audit checkpoint. Off without an address. The token is read from UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_TOKEN only.

mount.description: The Transit secrets engine's mount path. UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_MOUNT overrides it.

key.description: The Transit key name. UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_KEY overrides it.

role.description: Kubernetes auth role to sign in as with the pod's service account token. UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_ROLE overrides it.

authMount.description: The Kubernetes auth method's mount path. UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_AUTH_MOUNT overrides it.

jwtPath.description: Where the service account token is read, at every sign-in.

token.description: Not read from the configuration file; set UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_TOKEN from a secret.

checkpoints.description: The S3-compatible bucket audit checkpoints are copied to. Off without a URL. The access key pair is read from the environment only.

url.description: The bucket's URL, path style or virtual-hosted. UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_URL overrides it.

region.description: The region in the request signature; auto for Cloudflare R2. UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_REGION overrides it.

prefix.description: The object key prefix. UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_PREFIX overrides it.

lockDays.description: Days S3 Object Lock retains each object in compliance mode. UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_LOCK_DAYS overrides it.

accessKeyId.description: Not read from the configuration file; set UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_ACCESS_KEY_ID from a secret.

secretAccessKey.description: Not read from the configuration file; set UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY from a secret.

cards.description: Run cards and their binders and packs.

backfillPeriods.description: Closed periods a person's packs reach back before their first visit; 4 in demo mode.

teams.description: A sprint per Team in place of the ISO week.

anchor.description: A date a sprint starts on, such as 2026-09-28.

publishPullRequestComment.description: Whether Unfold comments a Run's card on its pull request.

rules.description: The card rules Unfold owns (root ADR-0030); each unset rule takes Ploeg's old default.

flow.description: Whether cards show flow (status time and gates).

rarity.description: true shows rarity to everyone, false turns it off; unset, the cards.rarity flag decides per person.

style.description: The repository's card skin and theme.

releaseEnvironment.description: Deployment environment that counts as a release.

sensitivePaths.description: Paths that make a change sensitive.

sizeExclude.description: Paths left out of the change size.

shape.description: Path patterns of a play's shape.

boards.description: Card rules per board, keyed <provider>:<board id> such as vikunja:10.

referees.description: Forge logins whose review counts as the referee's.

pullRequestComment.description: Whether the Team's pull requests get a card comment.

workingHours.description: The Team's working hours, which flow time counts.

cardThemes.description: Card themes administrators make, and optional generated art.

directory.description: Read-only folder of extra themes; it must exist.

assetQuotaMb.description: Space theme assets may take, in MiB.

ai.description: Art generation through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; ignored in demo mode.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as https://litellm.example/v1.

keyEnv.description: UNFOLD_ environment variable holding Unfold's own low-budget virtual key.

maxTokens.description: Most tokens one generation may produce.

timeoutMs.description: How long one generation may take, in milliseconds.

decider.description: The decider the tripwire asks (RFC-0008, ADR-0042). Absent, or in demo mode, the tripwire is off.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as https://litellm.example/v1.

keyEnv.description: UNFOLD_ environment variable holding Unfold's own zero-budget virtual key; it must be set.

judgeModels.description: Gateway models the judge may use, in order of preference; it never falls back to another.

judgement.description: The Work Kind expectations each Team pins over the defaults (RFC-0009).

readMinutes.description: Minutes a Run may read before its first change.

firstChangeMinutes.description: Minutes until the first change is expected.

verifyBeforeShip.description: Whether a Run must verify before it ships.

flags.description: Feature flag rules (ADR 0043): an inline flagd document, an optional watched file and the providers asked.

$schema.description: The flagd schema an editor checks the document against.

metadata.description: flagd document metadata; Unfold ignores it.

flags.description: Rules per flag key; a key the registry does not know is reported and left out.

defaultVariant.description: Variant served when targeting matches none.

metadata.description: Never set here: flag metadata belongs to the code's registry.

$evaluators.description: Shared JsonLogic fragments the rules refer to.

file.description: flagd file that wins over the inline rules and is watched. UNFOLD_FLAGS_FILE overrides it.

providers.description: Flag providers asked in order; the in-process flagd evaluator is always one of them.

kind.description: flagd is the in-process evaluator; ofrep asks an OFREP service.

name.description: Name of an OFREP provider; ofrep-<position> when absent.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the OFREP API key.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the OFREP bearer token.

timeoutMs.description: How long one OFREP request may take, in milliseconds.

cacheMs.description: How long an OFREP answer is reused, in milliseconds.

strategy.description: How providers combine: the first that knows the flag, or the first that answers without an error.

console.description: Whether administrators may author rollouts in Unfold.

delivery.description: Candidate verification and publishing under pinned policies. Needs execution; refused in demo mode.

verifierTokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the verifier credential.

socketPath.description: Docker socket of the docker verifier.

policies.description: One pinned verification policy per repository.

approvedBaseBundle.description: Absolute path of the git bundle of the approved base, outside dataDir.

image.description: Digest-pinned image the checks run in.

directory.description: Absolute path of the policy's pinned inputs, outside dataDir.

files.description: SHA-256 of each pinned input file, by relative path.

protectedPaths.description: Relative paths a candidate may not change.

checks.description: Commands that must print stdout and exit with exitCode.

id.description: Check name, unique in the policy.

argv.description: Command as argv; the first entry is an absolute path.

timeoutMs.description: How long each check may take, in milliseconds.

publisher.description: Opens the pull request of an approved candidate.

apiUrl.description: The forge's https API URL, without credentials.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the publisher token, shared with no agent, Ploeg consumer or verifier.

username.description: Forge user the token belongs to.

verifier.description: Where checks run: the local Docker engine, or a Kubernetes namespace.

kind.description: Verifier kind; docker takes no other setting.

image.description: Digest-pinned helper image providing a static /bin/busybox.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a check pod may run; it must outlast every check by 30 seconds.

networkProbe.description: An IP address and port check pods must not reach, proving their network is closed.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets check pods pull images with.

reports.description: Where Report a problem files: false turns it off; { source, project? } uses a task source with a token; { provider, baseUrl, project, tokenEnv } is a connection of its own. Absent, the first interactive source that can file issues; off in demo mode.

project.description: Repository or project on the report tracker; the source's own when absent.

acknowledgement.description: One line the success screen shows after a report is filed.

project.description: Repository or project reports are filed in.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the tracker token; unset keeps reports without filing them.

acknowledgement.description: One line the success screen shows after a report is filed.

notifications.description: The notification channels the deployment offers (system ADR-0026). Absent, none.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the ntfy access token.

publicKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the VAPID public key.

privateKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the VAPID private key.

slack.description: Notifications and answers through a Slack app; refused in demo mode.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the bot token (xoxb-…).

signingSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the signing secret.

teamId.description: The one workspace the app may serve, such as T012AB3C4.

permissionAnswers.description: Whether a person may answer their own tool-permission prompts from Slack.

teams.description: Microsoft Teams through Power Automate Workflows webhooks.

allowedHosts.description: Host suffixes a person's workflow URL may use.

budgetThresholds.description: Shares of a budget whose crossing notifies.

acceptanceCalendar.description: Extra non-working dates the silent Acceptance timer skips.

enforce.description: Limits every person to the repositories, task sources and Work Items their memberships reach.

allowedPrivateTargets.description: Non-public host names, addresses and CIDR ranges webhooks may still reach.

trustedProxies.description: Addresses and CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For names the client. Absent trusts none.

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security, sent only for an https baseUrl: false turns it off, true keeps the default, an object sets it.

includeSubDomains.description: Whether every host below the domain is included.

preload.description: Whether the host asks for the preload list; needs includeSubDomains and a maxAge of at least a year.

billing.description: One line per accepted Work Item into the Agency's billing tool (system ADR-0006); also behind the billing.export flag. Refused in demo mode.

exporter.description: Billing adapter; only its own block below is read.

syncMinutes.description: How often Unfold sends new lines, in minutes.

domain.description: Simplicate subdomain, such as agency for agency.simplicate.nl; required unless apiUrl is set.

apiUrl.description: Explicit API root in place of the subdomain; https except on loopback.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding the API key and secret as key:secret.

file.description: The file adapter: CSV and UBL files any tool imports.

directory.description: Folder the files are written to, relative to dataDir.

identity.description: SCIM provisioning and the Shared Signals receiver; both need auth.oidc.

tokenEnv.description: UNFOLD_ environment variable holding the bearer token the identity provider sends, at least 32 characters.

linkBy.description: SCIM User attribute that names the person who signs in.

audience.description: Audience a Security Event Token must name; baseUrl when absent.

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest Security Event Token accepted, in hours.

transmitters.description: Transmitters whose Security Event Tokens Unfold accepts.

jwksUri.description: Its signing keys; https except on loopback.

audience.description: Audience its tokens name, when not the receiver's.

authorizationEnv.description: UNFOLD_ environment variable holding the Authorization value it pushes with.

remoteRef.description: Where a secret lives in the store: remoteRef key, and optionally property and version. An empty key renders nothing.
